user.title: Add energy sensor
user.description: Builds a kWh sensor from a power sensor. {count} power sensors are not tracked yet.

data_description.periods: Daily / weekly / monthly / annual sensors that reset automatically.

user.title: Add constant load
user.description: For a device without a power meter: energy is counted at the rated wattage while the switch is on.

data_description.name: Optional. Leave empty to use the switch's name.

user.title: Add price add-on
user.description: Mirrors a price sensor (for example Nordpool) and adds a fixed amount, such as transmission fees or tax.

data_description.add_amount: In the same unit as the source sensor. Negative values subtract.
data_description.name: Optional. Leave empty to name it after the source and amount, for example "Nordpool + 0.25".

init.title: Settings
init.description: Calculation and diagnostic settings for every generated sensor. Defaults suit most installs. Sensors are added from the integration page, not here.

data_description.sample_interval: How often energy is calculated. 60 seconds suits most installs.
data_description.use_statistical_calculation: Integrate recorder history (the same approach as the Energy dashboard) instead of sampling live values.
data_description.force_statistical_only: Never fall back to live sampling, even while history is briefly unavailable.
data_description.stat_initial_lookback_minutes: How far back to look the first time a new sensor is created.
data_description.max_energy_per_hour: Reject any reading larger than this. 0 disables the limit.
data_description.create_synthetic_grid_total: One sensor that sums every generated main energy sensor.
data_description.debug_logging: Writes detailed calculation logs. Turn off afterwards to avoid log spam.
